annotations.title: nut
annotations.description: Below the collar is Nut, holding in each hand, and spreading her wings over the deceased to ward off evil influences.

annotations.title: shining-top
annotations.description: The first four of these are the sons of Horus, Imset and Duamutef (right side), and Hapi and Qebehsenuef (left side).

annotations.title: shining-bottom
annotations.description: The next three are Maitef and Horkhentyirty (right side), and Kherybaqef (left side), who together with the sons of Horus are the Seven Shining Ones, the protectors of the body of Osiris. The names of the latter two are no longer legible.

annotations.title: anubis
annotations.description: The eighth god is Anubis, the god associated with mummification. His name is no longer legible.

fragments.transliteration: ḫꜥ ḫrp sꜣ srqt Psmṯk-snb m Nfr-tm
fragments.translation: The healer Psamtik-Seneb appears as Nefertem,
the lotus at the nose of Re,
as he emerges from the horizon,
at the sight of which the gods become pure.

fragments.transliteration: ꜣḫw rḏj.n Jnpw m-ḥr sꜣ qrst nt Wsjr
fragments.translation: The akh spirits that Anubis has placed as protection over the sarcophagus of Osiris

fragments.transliteration: jw=sn m sꜣ qrst nt Wsjr
fragments.translation: are protection over the sarcophagus of the Osiris,
Words to be said: Your son Horus has come to you,

fragments.transliteration: nḏ.n=f ṯw ḫrp sꜣ srqt Psmṯk-snb mꜣꜥ-ḫrw
fragments.translation: that he may protect you, healer Psamtik-Seneb, justified.
Your mother Nut has given birth to you.
You will not need. You will not groan.
You will stand in front of the gods.
Words to be said: Horus has come to meet you,

fragments.transliteration: ṯs ṯw rs ṯw tp=k r ꜣḫt pr=k r pt
fragments.translation: Raise yourself, heed the horizon, so that you may ascend to the sky,

fragments.transliteration: ms.tj m Nwt ꜥnḫ.tj m-m sbꜣw
fragments.translation: born in Nut, living among the stars!

annotations.title: ḏd-mdw
annotations.description: ḏd-mdw literary words to be said
